name: Bari (Kitchen Garden) Scheme
benefit: Free Vegetable Seed Packets: Each eligible beneficiary receives a packet of vegetable seeds worth ₹75 free of cost.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a small or marginal farmer/agricultural laborer. - The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. - The applicant must belong to the Below the Poverty Line (BPL) category.
